facts.fact: Tech Review Africa reports Minister Frehiwot Tamru reiterating existing federal directives for public institutions to move away from standalone server facilities onto shared national infrastructure.
facts.system: Federal directives on consolidating public institutions' server infrastructure

ETH.note: The National Cloud Data Center is still under construction.

facts.fact: The minister ordered faster completion of the National Cloud Data Center, under construction at the Addis Ababa ICT Park to host government and other key national digital services, and reiterated directives to move public institutions off standalone servers.

ETH.note: The National Cloud Data Center is still under construction.

facts.fact: Minister Tamru said eligible startups would benefit from incentives and support under the country's ratified Startup Proclamation.
The minister visited InnoBiz-K Ethiopia, an incubation center supporting technology startups, with no programme or cohort described.
